wizard.patternSub: Pick what looks most like your arrangement. You can adjust day by day right after.
wizard.patternAlternateDesc: One week with each parent, with a fixed handover day.
wizard.patternWeekendDesc: The child lives with one parent; the other has every other weekend.
wizard.patternTwoTwoThreeDesc: 2 days each, then 3 days. Often chosen for young children.
wizard.patternCustomDesc: Place the days yourself over two weeks.
wizard.thumbLegend: Thumbnails: two weeks, Monday to Sunday; one color per parent.
wizard.whoWeekend: Who has {{child}} on the weekend of {{date}}?
wizard.weekendSub: The rest of the time, {{child}} lives with the other parent. Weekends then alternate on their own.
wizard.checkSub: A day doesn't fit? Tap it to give it to the other parent. The cycle then repeats every two weeks.
wizard.nowCustom: Your schedule becomes "custom". You can tap other days.
wizard.vacHalfDesc: Each break is split in two. The order flips every year.
wizard.vacFullDesc: The whole break with one parent, then with the other the next year.
wizard.vacWhoHalf: This year ({{year}}), who gets the first half?
wizard.vacWhoFull: This year ({{year}}), who gets the breaks?
wizard.vacExampleHalfMe: For example: at the next break, you get the first half and your co-parent the second. Next year, it flips.
wizard.vacExampleHalfOther: For example: at the next break, your co-parent gets the first half and you the second. Next year, it flips.
wizard.vacExampleFullMe: For example: this year the breaks are with you; next year, with your co-parent.
wizard.vacExampleFullOther: For example: this year the breaks are with your co-parent; next year, with you.
